source:
@@U02105@@
(Clasping him.)

@@U02106@@
It’s him! It’s him! Where is all my agony now? My misery, these chains, this dungeon? It’s you! Come to save me. I am saved! I see it, see the street again now where I first saw you, the pleasant garden where | waited for you with 玛尔特.

@@U02108@@
(Urging her to leave with him.)

@@U02109@@
Come with me! Come with me!

@@U02111@@
Oh, stay! Linger with me awhile. I love it where you are.

@@U02112@@
(忧愁ssing him.)

@@U02114@@
Hurry! Now! Hurry or we're lost.

@@U02116@@
What is it? Can't you kiss anymore? My love, parted for so short a time, and you've forgotten how to kiss? Why am I so afraid in your arms when, once, only a word, only a glance from you, and all Heaven descended upon me and you kissed me as if to smother me?
translation:
@@U02105@@
（抱紧他。）

@@U02106@@
是他！是他！现在我所有的痛苦都在哪里？我的痛苦，这些锁链，这个地牢？是你！快来救我吧。我得救了！我看到了，现在又看到了我第一次见到你的那条街道，那座宜人的花园 |和玛尔特一起等你。

@@U02108@@
（催促她和他一起离开。）

@@U02109@@
跟我来吧！跟我来吧！

@@U02111@@
哦，留下来！陪我呆一会儿。我喜欢你所在的地方。

@@U02112@@
（忧愁地抚摸着他。）

@@U02114@@
快点！现在！快点，不然我们就迷路了。

@@U02116@@
它是什么？不能再接吻了吗？亲爱的，分开这么短，你都忘记怎么接吻了吗？为什么我在你的怀里如此害怕，曾经，只要你的一句话，只要你的一个眼神，整个天堂就降临在我身上，你吻我，仿佛要窒息我？
